userIntent: Continue Bauman Hub continuously under the current Prompt System; keep the core local/offline/free-first and preserve learner truth while removing fragile localStorage dependency for canonical personal data.
objective: Introduce one normalized Hub personal-data storage facade with IndexedDB as the primary local canonical store, deterministic legacy migration, complete portable backup/restore, and compatibility-safe migration for Hub learner/auth/academic/scheduler/research data while keeping UI-only preferences lightweight.

trigger.reason: prompts/CONSTITUTION.md now inherits DEPENDENCY_INDEPENDENCE_POLICY.md; EXECUTION_PROTOCOL requires selective revalidation when an upstream owned contract affecting a PASS domain changes.

findings.summary: assets/js/main.js stores the complete Hub learner state in localStorage, including schedule entries, progress, deep-study journal, research checklist/files metadata, reports, capability/route receipts, review queue and activity. The new dependency policy limits localStorage to small non-critical preferences and requires a stronger local canonical data layer.
evidence: assets/js/main.js KEY='bauman_main_all_phases_subjects_v1'; readState()/save() read and write the full normalized state through localStorage.

defaultState()/normalizeState() include progress, schedule.entries, deepStudyJournal, subjectReports, subjectCapabilities, subjectRouteReceipts, reviewQueue, activity, researchChecks and researchFiles.

findings.summary: Academic diagnostic results and scheduler preview/transaction history are stored directly in localStorage even though they affect readiness/repair state, Apply/Rollback safety and user-specific evidence.
evidence: assets/js/academic-main.js persists bauman_academic_2026_diagnostics_v1 in localStorage and gateState()/scoreForGate() consume it.
assets/js/academic-scheduler-preview.js persists per-user scheduler previews in bauman_academic_2026_schedule_preview_v1.
assets/js/academic-scheduler-apply.js persists transaction history in bauman_academic_2026_schedule_transactions_v1 and uses it for rollback/history.

findings.summary: The current backup exports only {state, users}; separate Hub local data stores are omitted, so backup/restore is not a complete portable recovery path.
evidence: assets/js/main.js exportBackup() serializes only state and readUsers().
Separate localStorage stores exist for academic diagnostics, scheduler preview/transactions, Schedule notes, Subjects notes/custom courses/teacher overrides and Research tasks/notes.

findings.summary: Standalone users/current identity and managed compatibility profile are persisted in localStorage; credential verifiers are also included in the ordinary backup payload.
evidence: assets/js/main.js USERS_KEY and CURRENT_USER_KEY use localStorage; standalone user records contain PBKDF2 verifier material.
assets/js/app-manager-managed-access.js writes the managed compatibility profile to CURRENT_USER_KEY and clears the local credential key.
assets/js/main.js exportBackup() includes readUsers(), therefore passwordHash/passwordSalt/passwordIterations are currently exported in the ordinary backup.

findings.summary: Schedule notes, Subjects local notes/custom courses/teacher overrides and Research local tasks/notes are personal LOCAL_HUB data but are stored in independent localStorage keys outside the main backup.
evidence: assets/js/thesis-reference-v1.js TASK_KEY/NOTE_KEY store LOCAL_HUB research tasks and notes.

compliantExistingPatterns: assets/js/platform/device-access-gate.js already uses IndexedDB for Device Gate and sessionStorage for session state.
assets/js/platform/runtime-config.js defaults local runtime to 127.0.0.1 and uses injected/declared provider configuration rather than hard-coding a paid vendor.
Roadmap expansion/filter and Hub appearance/detail keys are small UI preferences and may remain in localStorage.
architectureInvariants: One Hub personal-data facade/source of truth; do not create parallel canonical stores.
IndexedDB is the primary browser canonical personal-data store for LOCAL_STABLE. OPFS may be used only if justified by file/blob needs; no paid/cloud provider is required.
localStorage may remain only for small non-critical UI preferences or explicitly non-authoritative compatibility caches.
Legacy localStorage migration is additive, deterministic, idempotent and retry-safe. Do not delete legacy keys until the new store has committed and validation has succeeded.
A failed/interrupted migration must leave prior data recoverable and must not reset progress/evidence.
CURRENT/STALE/UNAVAILABLE/LOCAL_HUB semantics remain unchanged; a stored real zero remains distinct from unavailable.
Do not migrate March-2025 reference/sample rows into canonical/local learner data. Existing legacy-sample filters in Subjects/Research remain effective.
Academic diagnostic evidence and scheduler transaction history retain per-user scoping and exact Apply/Rollback semantics.
Managed App Manager/Device Gate authority remains unchanged; storage migration must not turn the managed compatibility profile into auth truth.
General learner backup must be versioned, complete for canonical/local Hub personal data and round-trip restorable.
Ordinary learner backup must not silently export passwordHash/passwordSalt/legacy plaintext password. If credential export is supported, it requires a separate explicit secure contract.
No subject-private DB/localStorage/IndexedDB/DOM reads. No edits under subjects/** or prompts/subjects/**.
No Cloudflare/Vercel/Neon/Google service becomes required for LOCAL_STABLE.
Primary routes remain exactly Home, Roadmap, Subjects, Schedule, Research.

targetArchitecture.chain: Hub runtime → Personal Data Facade → IndexedDB provider → optional export/import → optional future sync adapters
targetArchitecture.canonicalLocalOwner: shared Hub personal-data facade under assets/js/platform/
targetArchitecture.preferences: small non-critical UI preferences may remain localStorage
targetArchitecture.identity: runtime/current-user accessor must not require localStorage as canonical auth state
targetArchitecture.migration: legacy keys → validate/filter → transactional IndexedDB write → parity check → mark migrated → retain legacy fallback until safe cleanup release

exactOwners: assets/js/main.js — canonical Hub state + standalone local user compatibility + backup/restore
index.html — storage bootstrap/load ordering if a new platform module is added
assets/js/platform/* — shared Hub platform boundary; add exactly one storage facade/provider owner
forbiddenPaths: control-service/** unless a proven migration blocker requires a separate packet
retainAsPreference: Schedule selected day/week/month view when not carrying learner notes/evidence
implementationPhases: P1 — Reconfirm exact current main; inspect only changed allowed-path owners since this packet baseline and avoid conflicts.
P2 — Add one shared async Hub personal-data facade with schema/versioning and IndexedDB provider. Do not duplicate Device Gate DB semantics unless a shared lower-level helper is genuinely reusable.
P3 — Bootstrap main state through the facade before app render; preserve synchronous consumer behavior through an initialized in-memory state, not by treating localStorage as canonical.
P4 — Migrate standalone users/current identity compatibility safely. Keep Device Gate/App Manager authority unchanged. Remove credential verifier material from ordinary learner backup.
P5 — Move academic diagnostic, scheduler preview and transaction stores behind the facade while preserving per-user scope, fingerprints, Apply/Rollback and legacy migration behavior.
P6 — Move Schedule/Subjects/Research LOCAL_HUB notes/tasks/custom/teacher data behind the facade. Preserve truth-safe filters so reference samples are never promoted.
P7 — Replace backup/restore with a versioned portable bundle covering all canonical/local Hub personal data. Add deterministic round-trip validation and legacy import.
P8 — Add migration interruption/retry, real-zero/unavailable, offline reload, managed/standalone auth, academic transaction and backup round-trip browser/static tests.
P9 — Run targeted + whole-system regression at one exact SHA; write CURRENT_EXECUTION_RESULT.json. Do not deploy production.
acceptanceCriteria: Core Hub startup and all five primary routes work with localStorage canonical-data keys absent after successful migration.
IndexedDB/facade holds canonical Hub state, academic diagnostics and scheduler transaction history with explicit schema versions.
Existing real learner data migrates exactly once without reset; rerunning migration is idempotent.
Interrupted migration is retry-safe and legacy data remains recoverable until migration commit/parity verification succeeds.
Stored progress 0 remains CURRENT=0; missing remains UNAVAILABLE; no truth regression.
March-2025 sample/reference constants are not migrated as learner data; legacy sample IDs remain filtered.
Academic diagnostic state survives reload and continues to drive the same gate classification.
Scheduler preview/apply/rollback transaction history survives reload; stale/fingerprint/manual/external protection behavior is unchanged.
Schedule/Subjects/Research user-created notes/tasks/custom overrides survive migration and are restored by backup.
Roadmap/appearance/view-only preferences may continue using localStorage without becoming canonical learner truth.
Managed App Manager + Device Gate flows and standalone local mode both pass; no new provider/network requirement is introduced.
Versioned backup export contains all canonical/local learner data required for recovery and round-trips cleanly.
Ordinary learner backup contains no passwordHash, passwordSalt, passwordIterations or legacy plaintext password fields.
No subject-private path/state access is introduced.
Desktop/mobile/offline browser acceptance has no console/page errors or horizontal overflow.
LOCAL_STABLE is achieved at one exact tested SHA; production remains NOT_DEPLOYED.
requiredTests: New browser migration test: seeded legacy keys → first boot migration → reload → exact data parity.
Backup export/import round-trip including main state, diagnostics, transactions and LOCAL_HUB notes/tasks/custom overrides.
Credential redaction assertion for ordinary backup.
academic-browser-acceptance-13e (diagnostic persistence, preview, Apply/Rollback, offline grace).
system-browser-acceptance / packaged whole-system gate as currently required by CI.

auth: no credential verifier in ordinary backup

releasePolicy: Target LOCAL_STABLE only. No production deployment, managed backend requirement or paid provider introduction from this packet.
rollbackNotes: Keep all legacy localStorage canonical-data keys untouched until the IndexedDB write, schema validation and parity check succeed. On failure, continue reading the legacy source and surface migration status; never clear learner data. Production is outside scope.
stopCondition: Codex stops after exact-head LOCAL_STABLE static + browser + whole-system evidence is green and CURRENT_EXECUTION_RESULT.json is written, or records a genuine blocker. Do not deploy production.
